svg.title: How the model works
svg.desc: Each audio clip is read three ways. What was said: Whisper transcribes with a verbatim prompt, and DeBERTa-v3-large scores the transcript, frozen with a ridge and fine-tuned. How it was said: WavLM, WavLM-large and the Whisper encoder give pooled embeddings for ridge and SVR models. Heard by a language model: Voxtral-Mini-3B hidden states feed a ridge and an attention-pooling head. A non-negative blend with a score-0 gate and separate weights for the 45 s recording batch combines them, then a measured test bias is removed and full-length clips are stretched, giving a 0 to 5 score.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: ONE CLIP, THREE WAYS OF HEARING IT
